source_boundaries.deuteronomy_keil: Source explicitly moves from book preface into Deu 1:1-4 exposition; original single SWORD record retained.
source_boundaries.joshua_keil: Source explicitly changes from prophetic-history group introduction to book introduction and then to Jos 1:1 exposition; original 81,332-character record retained.
source_boundaries.joshua_matthew_henry: Source preface Joshua to Esther divided at explicit paragraph beginning II. We have next before us the book of Joshua; its first verse commentary remains separate.
source_boundaries.jfb_multiple_headings: All source-tagged headings reviewed across source entries and restricted to explicit numbered verse ranges; two unstyled headings Deu 14:1-2/Jos 23:1-2 source-captured.
source_boundaries.not_inferred: JFB headings are not promoted from citations embedded in ordinary commentary; overlapping native SWORD passage ranges are source index facts only.
source_boundaries.original_scripts_preserved: No historical record fields changed; source fragments are separately hashed.

jfb_held_introductions.change: None. Poetical / prophetical / restoration groups not activated in Deuteronomy or Joshua.

new_book_group_mapping.jfb_pentateuch_and_historical_books: Joshua now included, using the original retained Genesis JFB introduction source. Deuteronomy remains covered as part of Pentateuch.
new_book_group_mapping.matthew_henry_historical_volume: Joshua to Esther begins at Joshua; no projection to unprocessed books without mapping.
new_book_group_mapping.keil_prophetical_histories: Joshua is included, future Judges/Samuel/Kings require explicit book-by-book mapping.
